description.purpose: AIAGD defines the AI architecture domain delta for governing AI system architecture structure, architecture claims, component responsibilities, interfaces, data flows, trust and authority boundaries as architecture objects, AI component placement, failure propagation design, fallback and containment design, deployment topology as architecture structure, migration and replacement planning, runtime conformance claims, and architecture lineage.
description.core_principle: govern only AI system architecture structure and architecture claims; do not absorb agentic execution, authority decision, AI security risk judgment, operations execution, implementation quality, development consultation, artifact composition, or domain routing

domain_scope.scope_statement: governs AI system architecture structure and architecture-readiness claims across objectives, requirements, quality attributes, component placement, responsibility, interfaces, data flows, trust boundaries, authority-boundary placement, AI component placement, failure propagation design, fallback design, deployment topology, migration planning, and runtime conformance claims

abstraction_and_context_policy.purpose: keep AI architecture rules at architecture-governance abstraction level and prevent case-specific systems, vendors, tools, or operational practices from becoming universal rules

role_complete_separation.principle: AIAGD must keep source material, inherited governance, sibling references, governed architecture targets, evaluation, repair, activation, status, records, external orchestration, and metadata responsibilities separated

separation_targets.source_material: inputs, diagrams, notes, architecture descriptions, logs, or prior materials used as evidence or context but not absorbed as rules by default
separation_targets.domain_definition: AI architecture specific rules, checks, failures, repair origins, records, and responsibility boundaries
separation_targets.inherited_governance: ARGD and DAGD mechanisms referenced as authoritative external governance rather than reexpanded here
separation_targets.sibling_reference: nearby domain definitions referenced only for boundary and handoff conditions
separation_targets.governed_target: AI system architecture object, architecture claim, architecture decision, architecture record, or architecture conformance condition being governed
separation_targets.domain_evaluation: architecture-specific evaluation axes and readiness claim checks
separation_targets.domain_repair: architecture-specific repair origins and affected revalidation scopes
separation_targets.activation: local applicability signals only; routing and priority remain external
separation_targets.records: minimal architecture records that remain structurally separate from evaluation, repair, and metadata
separation_targets.external_orchestration: routing, registry, priority, and domain selection remain external
separation_targets.metadata: identity, authorship, license, repository, and compatibility information

cross_domain_interference_policy.purpose: prevent AIAGD from absorbing sibling domain authority when AI systems contain overlapping agent, security, authority, operation, implementation, consultation, or artifact concerns

architecture_object.purpose: represent the governed AI system architecture identity, scope, state, and lineage

architecture_requirement.purpose: represent a requirement as an architecture input rather than as implementation work or final approval

quality_attribute.purpose: represent measurable or reviewable architecture quality expectations and tradeoffs

component.purpose: represent an architecture component and its responsibility boundary

interface_contract.purpose: represent architecture-level connection contract and failure behavior between components

data_flow.purpose: represent architecture-level data movement, transformation, sensitivity, and lineage

trust_boundary.purpose: represent trust transition and validation structure without assigning final authority

authority_boundary_structure.purpose: represent authority-sensitive architecture structure without making authority, approval, delegation, or accountability decisions

ai_component_placement.purpose: represent AI-specific component placement and separation without governing runtime execution

deployment_topology_structure.purpose: represent deployment topology as architecture structure without claiming live operational health

architecture_process.purpose: define a compact AI architecture governance process focused on architecture structure and readiness claims

architecture_intent_and_scope_definition.purpose: define architecture objective, scope, non-scope, stakeholders, affected subjects, and primary architecture claim type

architecture_requirement_and_quality_att.purpose: define architecture requirements, quality attributes, priorities, acceptance criteria, and tradeoffs

candidate_architecture_generation.purpose: generate and preserve viable architecture candidates before selecting a structure

component_responsibility_definition.purpose: define components and their responsibility and non-responsibility boundaries

interface_and_data_flow_definition.purpose: define component interfaces, data flows, data categories, lineage, and failure behavior

trust_and_authority_boundary_structure_d.purpose: define trust boundaries and authority-sensitive boundary structures without making authority decisions

ai_component_placement_definition.purpose: define model, retrieval, memory, tool, agent, policy, safety, evaluation, observability, and human review point placement

policy_evaluation_observability_and_revi.purpose: define placement of policy, evaluation, observability, and review points without claiming final approval or operational health

failure_propagation_and_containment_desi.purpose: define architecture-level failure propagation, blast radius, containment, fallback, and recovery path design

deployment_topology_structure_definition.purpose: define deployment topology as architecture structure and connect it to runtime conformance claim conditions

architecture_tradeoff_and_decision_recor.purpose: record selected architecture decisions, alternatives, rejected options, tradeoffs, assumptions, and overturn conditions

architecture_falsification_and_conforman.purpose: apply architecture-specific falsification and review runtime conformance claims

migration_and_replacement_planning.purpose: define architecture-level migration and replacement plan without executing migration

architecture_repair_origin_and_lineage_r.purpose: identify repair origin, affected architecture scope, revalidation scope, and lineage requirements

architecture_falsification.purpose: apply parent reasoning falsification to architecture-specific assumptions and claims without reimplementing parent FALS

repair.purpose: define AI architecture specific repair origins and affected revalidation scope without replacing parent repair governance

architecture_process_record.purpose: record the architecture structure, decisions, boundaries, placement, conformance claim, and lineage relevant to AIAGD

architecture_evaluation_and_conformance_.purpose: record architecture readiness, conformance-claim status, critical invalidation, repair origin, revalidation scope, and sibling handoff conditions
